titulo: You can now turn off Google Gemini’s visible watermarks
cuerpo: Google will now allow you to remove visible watermarks from the images, videos, and music made with AI tools. With the update, you can toggle off a new "Media watermark" setting in Gemini and Google's AI video generator, Flow.
